title: Character Feature
description: Schema for a character feature in the game

foundryID.description: The source system's stable record identifier

traits.description: List of traits associated with this feature

grantedSpells.description: Spells this feature grants: focus spells and focus cantrips join the class's focus source; known spells join its repertoire or spellbook, and the known-choice spells are one choice between them.

curriculum.description: A wizard school's curriculum: the spells of each rank (0 for cantrips).

spellcasting.description: A caster's slots and spell picks, written once, as the book's table. Authoring shorthand: reading the archive expands it into the record's first rules (configure-source, increase-spell-proficiency, grant-slot and add-known-spell), with IDs derived from the record's path. `source` is {kind, tradition, attribute} to define a source, or an @ reference to the feature that defines it; `slots` maps a level to its cumulative row (cantrips, then ranks 1-10); `spellbook` maps a level or range (2-20) to its picks (cantrips, rank-N, any-rank, new-slots).

source.description: {kind, tradition, attribute}, or an @ reference to the feature that defines the source

tradition.description: For a block that adds to another record's source and picks from a tradition list

ids.description: The folder whose name the rule IDs derive from, when it is not features

choose.description: One more spellbook pick, from exactly these spells (@ references)

facts.description: The facts the record states about itself, which a rule can read: a name to a whole number, a flag, a term of a vocabulary, a reference to a record (omen://), or a list of these. The publication declares each fact for the record's collection in its facts; the archive check holds a value to its declaration.

unsupportedCategory.description: What the unapplied rules cost a player: numbers (a bonus, Speed, proficiency rank or skill is wrong or missing), choice (a choice the book allows can't be made), benefit (a benefit the book grants is not applied), text (the rule is in the description and the player applies it) or scope (a table or encounter concern a builder doesn't need). Required with unsupportedReason; the reason says what is missing in words. From format 6.
